title: Exchange key-matching trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for rabbitmq-binding-vs-routing-key trace events.

exchange.description: The single exchange whose matching rule is being demonstrated.

type.description: The comparison rule applied to a binding key and a routing key.

isDefault.description: True for the nameless default exchange, where the broker binds every queue itself.

bindings.description: Bindings in declaration order; the exchange tries them in this order.

key.description: The binding key; empty when the binding carries none.

verdict.description: How this binding key compared against the current message's routing key.

implicit.description: True when the broker created this binding itself (default exchange).

queues.description: Declared queues with the copies routed into them, oldest first.

routingKey.description: The routing key this copy arrived with — it travels with the message.

message.description: The message currently being routed (absent on topology events).

literalWildcard.description: The routing key contains '*' or '#', which are ordinary characters there.

copies.description: Total copies stored across all queues; one publish can produce several.
